theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 28 群

items.colloc: paint an outdoor wall 粉刷外牆 | repair the outdoor wall 修復外牆
items.distinct: exterior wall 外牆 | facade 建築正面
ex: The outdoor wall requires a fresh coat of paint.
這面室外牆需要重新粉刷。
Maintenance crews are fixing the damaged outdoor wall.
維修人員正在修復受損的室外牆。
We installed security cameras on the outdoor wall.
我們在室外牆上安裝了監視攝影機。

items.colloc: over price the product 把產品定價過高 | avoid over pricing 避免定價過高
items.distinct: overcharge 索價過高 | inflate price 哄抬價格
ex: Do not over price the items in our new catalog.
別把我們新目錄中的商品定價過高。
They tend to over price their services during the peak season.
他們傾向在旺季將服務定價過高。
If you over price the inventory, sales will likely decline.
如果你將庫存定價過高，銷售量可能會下降。

items.colloc: a roll of packing tape 一卷封箱膠帶 | use packing tape 使用包裝膠帶
items.distinct: masking tape 遮蔽膠帶 | duct tape 強力膠帶
ex: Please seal the cardboard boxes with packing tape.
請用包裝膠帶把紙箱封好。
We ran out of packing tape in the shipping department.
運務部門的包裝膠帶用完了。
Secure the package firmly using high-quality packing tape.
使用高品質的包裝膠帶將包裹牢固封好。

items.colloc: pair up with a partner 與夥伴搭檔 | pair up with a colleague 與同事配對
items.distinct: team up with 與…組隊 | partner with 與…合作
ex: You should pair up with a colleague for this task.
你應該找位同事搭檔完成這項任務。
Employees were asked to pair up with someone from another department.
員工被要求與其他部門的人配對。
I will pair up with him to finish the final report.
我會和他搭檔來完成最後的報告。

items.pos: phr. 忽視；略過；不予考慮
items.colloc: pass over a candidate 略過候選人 | pass over an opportunity 錯過機會
items.distinct: overlook 忽略 | bypass 越過
ex: He was passed over for the promotion last year.
他去年升遷時被跳過了。
The committee decided to pass over that proposal for now.
委員會決定暫時擱置那個提案。
Management should not pass over such a talented employee.
管理層不該忽視如此有才華的員工。

items.colloc: pass up a chance 錯失機會 | pass up an offer 放棄提議
items.distinct: give up 放棄 | miss out 錯失
ex: It is an opportunity you should not pass up.
這是一個你不該錯過的好機會。
She decided to pass up the job offer in London.
她決定放棄倫敦那份工作邀約。
We cannot afford to pass up such a lucrative contract.
我們承擔不起錯失這份有利可圖的合約。

items.pos: phr. 得到回報；償清（債務）
items.colloc: pay off the debt 還清債務 | the effort paid off 努力得到回報
items.distinct: pay back 償還 | pay up 付清
ex: Their hard work finally paid off with a big contract.
他們的努力最終獲得了一份大合約作為回報。
We need to pay off our company loans within two years.
我們需要在兩年內還清公司貸款。
The new marketing strategy is expected to pay off soon.
新的行銷策略預計很快就會見效。

items.colloc: request a pay raise 要求加薪 | receive a pay raise 獲得加薪
items.distinct: salary increase 加薪 | promotion 升遷
ex: He is planning to ask his boss for a pay raise.
他正計畫向老闆提出加薪要求。
The employees are negotiating for a significant pay raise.
員工們正在協商爭取顯著的加薪。
Performance reviews are often linked to a potential pay raise.
績效考核通常與潛在的加薪掛鉤。

items.colloc: declare personal effects 申報個人物品 | store personal effects 存放個人物品
items.distinct: belongings 財產 | property 資產
ex: Passengers must declare any personal effects at customs.
旅客必須在海關申報所有個人物品。
Please remove all personal effects from your desk before moving.
搬遷前請清空辦公桌上的所有個人物品。
The insurance policy covers loss of personal effects during travel.
保險單涵蓋旅行期間個人物品的遺失。

items.zh: 個人管理；人力資源管理
items.colloc: improve personal management 提升個人管理 | effective personal management 有效的個人管理
items.distinct: time management 時間管理 | personnel management 人事管理
ex: Effective personal management is crucial for career success.
有效的個人管理對職涯成功至關重要。
She took a seminar on personal management and organization.
她參加了一場關於個人管理與組織的研討會。
Good personal management helps reduce stress in the workplace.
良好的個人管理有助於減少職場壓力。

items.colloc: pick up the phone promptly 迅速接電話 | fail to pick up the phone 未能接聽
items.distinct: answer the phone 回應電話 | dial a number 撥號
ex: No one picked up the phone when I called the office.
我打電話到辦公室時沒人接聽。
You should pick up the phone if it rings during the meeting.
如果會議中電話響了，你應該接聽。
She was too busy to pick up the phone yesterday afternoon.
她昨天下午忙到無法接電話。

items.colloc: state the place of origin 說明原產地 | verify the place of origin 核實產地
items.distinct: source 來源 | location 地點
ex: The label must clearly indicate the product's place of origin.
標籤必須清楚標示產品的原產地。
We need to confirm the place of origin for these raw materials.
我們需要確認這些原材料的原產地。
Customs officials checked the goods and their place of origin.
海關官員檢查了貨物及其原產地。

items.colloc: plenty of time 充裕的時間 | plenty of resources 大量的資源
items.distinct: a lot of 許多的 | abundant 豐富的
ex: We have plenty of time to finish the project proposal.
我們有充裕的時間完成專案企劃書。
There is plenty of space in the new office building.
新的辦公大樓有充足的空間。
The company has plenty of resources to invest in research.
這家公司有大量的資源可以投資研發。

items.colloc: reach a potential customer 接觸潛在客戶 | attract potential customers 吸引潛在客戶
items.distinct: existing customer 現有客戶 | target audience 目標受眾
ex: Our sales team is reaching out to every potential customer.
我們的業務團隊正在接觸每一位潛在客戶。
We aim to convert potential customers into long-term clients.
我們的目標是將潛在客戶轉化為長期合作夥伴。
Providing free samples is a great way to attract potential customers.
提供免費樣品是吸引潛在客戶的好方法。

items.colloc: gain practical experience 獲得實務經驗 | relevant practical experience 相關實務經驗
items.distinct: theoretical knowledge 理論知識 | hands-on experience 親手實作經驗
ex: The job description requires at least three years of practical experience.
職位描述要求至少三年的實務經驗。
Internships allow students to gain valuable practical experience.
實習讓學生能獲得寶貴的實務經驗。
He lacks the practical experience needed for this managerial position.
他缺乏擔任此管理職位所需的實務經驗。

items.colloc: provide a price quote 提供報價 | request a price quote 要求報價
items.distinct: estimate 估價 | invoice 發票
ex: Please send us a price quote for the office renovation.
請寄給我們辦公室裝修的報價單。
We requested a formal price quote from three different suppliers.
我們向三家不同的供應商要求正式報價。
The price quote will remain valid for thirty days only.
此報價僅在三十天內有效。

items.colloc: work as a product designer 擔任產品設計師 | hire a product designer 聘請產品設計師
items.distinct: graphic designer 平面設計師 | interior designer 室內設計師
ex: The product designer created a sleek and modern laptop.
產品設計師設計了一款時尚且現代的筆記型電腦。
Our company is looking for an experienced product designer.
我們公司正在尋找一位有經驗的產品設計師。
The product designer collaborates closely with the engineering team.
產品設計師與工程團隊密切合作。

items.colloc: set up a product display 架設產品展示 | improve the product display 改進產品陳列
items.distinct: product launch 產品發表 | showroom 展示間
ex: The new product display caught the attention of many shoppers.
新的產品展示吸引了許多顧客的注意。
Retail staff must maintain a clean and attractive product display.
門市人員必須維持整潔且吸引人的商品陳列。
We decided to change the product display for the holiday season.
我們決定為節慶季節更改產品展示方式。

items.colloc: provide proof of employment 提供在職證明 | request proof of employment 要求工作證明
items.distinct: certificate of graduation 畢業證書 | transcript 成績單
ex: You need to submit a letter as proof of employment.
你需要提交一封信作為在職證明。
The bank requested proof of employment for the loan application.
銀行要求提供貸款申請的在職證明。
Human resources will issue your proof of employment tomorrow.
人力資源部明天會核發你的在職證明。

items.colloc: mark the property line 標示地界線 | cross the property line 越過地界線
items.distinct: boundary 界線 | border 國界；邊境
ex: The fence was built exactly on the property line.
圍籬正好建在土地界線上。
We need to survey the land to determine the property line.
我們需要測量土地以確定地界線。
Any construction must stay within the legal property line.
任何建築工程都必須保持在合法的土地範圍內。
